answer: Because the mirror ledger attributes every share, the river audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 68% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not pay. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it forfeits the signal fee twice and still divides one payout. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
